item.summary: The 2nd Meeting of the India-Indonesia Working Group on Trade and Investment (WGTI) was held at Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi, in hybrid mode. The Indian delegation was led by Joint Secretary, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Shri Amit Verma, and the Indonesian delegation by Director of Bilateral Negotiation, Ministry of Trade, Indonesia, Ms Basaria Tiara Desika L. Gaol.…
item.title: India and Indonesia Review Trade and Economic Cooperation at 2nd Working Group on Trade and Investment Meeting in New Delhi
